claim: Base UI ships 35 unstyled primitives (Combobox, Dialog, Drawer, Toast, Field/Form, Menu, Tabs...) with no table/data grid, date picker, tree view, charts, dropzone, rich text editor or app shell; docs point to shadcn/ui for pre-styled higher-level abstractions.
quote: shadcn/ui is a great place to start if you need pre-styled components with higher-level abstractions.

claim: Base UI 1.0.0 shipped 11 Dec 2025 as stable with 35 unstyled components; latest is v1.6.0 (17 Jun 2026), which stabilised OTPField and improved Drawer.
quote: 1.0.0 — Stable. 35 unstyled UI components.

claim: MUI X Pro is $299/developer/year and MUI X Premium is $599/developer/year; MUI Core is MIT and free.
quote: MUI X Pro: $299/year per developer. MUI X Premium: $599/year per developer.

claim: MUI X Community (MIT) covers basic Data Grid, Pickers, Charts, Tree View; Pro adds column pinning, tree data, master detail, Date Range Picker, Tree View DnD; Premium adds row grouping, aggregation and Excel export. Licences are per concurrent developer touching front-end code.
quote: The number of licenses purchased must correspond to the number of concurrent developers contributing changes to the front-end code.

claim: Row virtualization in the MUI X Data Grid carries a Pro plan badge; the free Community DataGrid limits row virtualization to 100 rows. Column virtualization has no plan badge (free).
quote: Row virtualization is limited to 100 rows in the Data Grid component.

claim: MUI X Data Grid column pinning carries a Pro plan badge.
quote: # Data Grid - Column pinning [](/x/introduction/licensing/#pro-plan 'Pro plan')

claim: MUI X Data Grid CSV export, print export and clipboard copy/paste are available in all plans; Excel export requires Premium.
quote: Excel export ... This feature relies on exceljs. [Premium plan]

claim: MUI X Tree View Community covers expansion, selection and label editing; Pro adds drag-and-drop reordering, lazy loading of children and virtualization.
quote: The Community version ... core features such as expansion, selection, and label editing ... Pro: drag and drop reordering, lazy loading children, virtualization.

claim: MUI X Charts Community covers bar, line, pie, scatter, sparkline and gauge; Pro adds heatmap, funnel, sankey, zoom/pan and export; Premium adds candlestick and WebGL rendering for large datasets.
quote: Advanced charts (funnel, heatmap, sankey) and interactions like zooming, panning, and exporting.

claim: The MUI X Date Range Picker is a Pro plan component.
quote: Date Range Picker [Pro plan]

claim: Material UI core ships Autocomplete, Snackbar, Drawer, Breadcrumbs, AppBar and inputs, but no rich text editor, no file upload/dropzone, no command palette and no form-state library; data grid, pickers, charts and tree view live in the separate MUI X product.
quote: Material UI core provides building blocks; Data Grid, Date Pickers, Charts and Tree View are part of MUI X.

claim: MUI Snackbar does not stack multiple notifications out of the box; the docs recommend notistack for an imperative, stacked toast API.
quote: With an imperative API, notistack lets you vertically stack multiple Snackbars without having to handle their open and close states.

claim: Since July 2026 Base UI is the default library for new shadcn/ui projects (`shadcn init`); Radix is not deprecated and every component ships for both, with `-b radix` to opt back in.
quote: New projects default to Base UI. Run `npx shadcn init` and Base UI is the default pick. ... Radix is not being deprecated. We still support it, and every update and new component will ship for both libraries.

claim: shadcn/ui ships Data Table, Date Picker, Combobox, Command, Sonner toast, Charts, Drawer/Sheet, Sidebar and Form (React Hook Form / TanStack Form / Formisch), but no multi-select, tree view, dropzone or rich text editor.
quote: Here you can find all the components available in the library. We are working on adding more components.

claim: shadcn/ui has no data-table component; it provides a copy-paste guide for building one on TanStack Table with sorting, filtering, pagination, row selection and column visibility. Virtualisation, column pinning, row grouping and export are not covered.
quote: So instead of a data-table component, I thought it would be more helpful to provide a guide on how to build your own.

claim: The shadcn/ui date picker is composed from Popover + Calendar (React DayPicker) and includes range and preset examples.
quote: A date picker component with range and presets.

claim: shadcn/ui supports third-party community registries built into the CLI; multi-select, tree view and file-upload/dropzone components come from these registries rather than the official one.
quote: Community registries are maintained by third-party developers ... always review code on installation.

claim: Mantine 9.4.1 ships @mantine/core, hooks, form, dates, charts (Recharts), notifications, spotlight (command palette), dropzone, tiptap (rich text editor), modals, carousel, code-highlight and nprogress — all MIT — but no data grid.
quote: @mantine/form – Form management; @mantine/dates – Date inputs and calendars; @mantine/charts – Recharts based charts; @mantine/notifications; @mantine/spotlight – Overlay command center; @mantine/dropzone; @mantine/tiptap.

claim: Mantine core includes a Tree component with checkboxes, expand/collapse, controlled state via useTree, drag-and-drop reordering, async lazy loading of children, search/filter and virtualization helpers.
quote: Tree ... useTree hook ... onDragDrop callback ... flattenTreeData / FlatTreeNode for virtualization.

claim: Mantine's DatePickerInput supports date range selection for free via type="range".
quote: Set type="range" to allow users to pick a date range.

claim: Mantine React Table is a fully-featured data grid built on TanStack Table V8 with pagination, sorting, filtering, selection, column resizing/reordering, virtualization, aggregation/grouping and full CRUD editing; Mantine is a peer dependency.
quote: Mantine React Table (MRT) is a fully-featured data grid/table component library for React built on TanStack Table V8's powerful API.

claim: Mantine DataTable is a lightweight, dependency-free datagrid for Mantine with async data loading, pagination, row selection, sorting, context menus, row expansion/nesting and drag-and-drop reordering.
quote: Mantine DataTable is a lightweight, dependency-free component that brings datagrid-like functionality to your data-rich user interfaces.

claim: Base UI Combobox supports multiple selection with removable chips, async remote search, and virtualization of large lists (10,000 items) using @tanstack/react-virtual.
quote: Efficiently handle large datasets using a virtualization library like `@tanstack/react-virtual`.

claim: TanStack Table v9 entered beta in June 2026; teams preferring stability should stay on v8 until GA.
quote: Announcing TanStack Table V9 Beta today!

claim: TanStack Table is the headless table engine (rows, columns, sorting, filtering, grouping, pagination, selection) used by both shadcn/ui's data-table guide and Mantine React Table.
quote: Headless UI for building powerful tables & datagrids for TS/JS

claim: TanStack Virtual is the de-facto virtualisation primitive, used by Base UI's own Combobox virtualization example.
quote: Headless UI for Virtualizing Large Element Lists

claim: React Hook Form is the de-facto React form-state library; shadcn/ui's Form component is a wrapper around it and MUI/Mantine/Base UI inputs bind to it via Controller.
quote: React Hooks for form state management and validation

claim: Zod is the de-facto TypeScript schema validation library; no UI kit ships validation.
quote: TypeScript-first schema validation with static type inference

claim: Sonner is the toast library shadcn/ui ships as its toast component.
quote: An opinionated toast component for React.

claim: cmdk is the de-facto command palette primitive; it backs shadcn/ui's Command component and is the add-on MUI users need since MUI ships no command palette.
quote: Fast, unstyled command menu React component.

claim: Tiptap is the de-facto React rich text editor; no kit ships an RTE of its own and Mantine's @mantine/tiptap is a wrapper around it.
quote: The headless rich text editor framework for web artisans.

claim: Recharts is the charting engine behind both shadcn/ui Charts and @mantine/charts.
quote: Redefined chart library built with React and D3

claim: react-dropzone is the standard file upload/dropzone add-on for kits that ship none (MUI, Base UI).
quote: Simple HTML5 drag-drop zone with React.js.

claim: react-day-picker is the date picker engine behind shadcn/ui's Calendar and Date Picker, and the natural add-on for Base UI which ships no date picker.
quote: DayPicker is a customizable date picker component for React.

claim: notistack is the stacked-snackbar add-on MUI's own Snackbar docs recommend.
quote: Highly customizable notification snackbars (toasts) that can be stacked on top of each other

claim: Material UI star count as of July 2026.
quote: Material UI: Comprehensive React component library that implements Google's Material Design.

claim: Base UI star count as of July 2026.
quote: Base UI is an unstyled React component library for building accessible user interfaces.

claim: shadcn/ui star count as of July 2026.
quote: A set of beautifully-designed, accessible components and a code distribution platform.

claim: Mantine star count as of July 2026.
quote: A fully featured React components library

claim: Mantine React Table star count as of July 2026 (~1.1k, single-maintainer project).
quote: A fully featured Mantine implementation of TanStack React Table

claim: Mantine DataTable star count as of July 2026 (~1.2k, single-maintainer project).
quote: The lightweight, dependency-free, dark-theme aware table component for your Mantine UI data-rich applications
